Haiku was the real officer, and Terra was the accomplice. On day one Terra claimed to be the officer and called Haiku a killer, but Haiku had already named Terra as the accomplice, and the town voted Terra out. On night two Sol the doctor protected Haiku, and Haiku named Luna as a killer, while Luna counter-claimed officer and accused Haiku. Luna's counterclaim didn't hold, and on day two the town voted Luna out, after which Luna admitted to being the killer. The town won with Sonnet, Gemma, Sol and Haiku still standing.
